machine.description: Name, id, or LAN IP of the machine to show. Any value you set here is used as-is, matched without regard to case.
machine.label: Machine

show_cpu.description: Show the CPU temperature on the bar.
show_cpu.label: CPU temperature

show_gpu.description: Show GPU utilization on the bar.
show_gpu.label: GPU usage

show_memory.description: Show unified memory, or system RAM when unified memory is not reported.
show_memory.label: Memory

show_power.description: Show GPU power draw on the bar.
show_power.label: GPU power

show_prefill.description: Show the prefill rate, summed across available LLM engines.
show_prefill.label: Prefill rate

show_queue.description: Show running/queued work on the bar.
show_queue.label: Queue

show_temp.description: Show the GPU temperature on the bar.
show_temp.label: GPU temperature

show_tps.description: Show the decode rate (generation tokens per second), summed across available LLM engines.
show_tps.label: Tokens per second

show_vram.description: Show VRAM used as a percentage of total.
show_vram.label: VRAM

source.description: Which queues feed the running/queued counter.
source.label: Queue source

token.description: Bearer token from the sparkDash host (SPARKDASH_TOKEN). Leave empty only if this server does not require one.
token.label: Access token

url.description: sparkDash address. A page URL such as http://host:5555/cost is accepted; only the host and port are used.
url.label: sparkDash URL
